## Read in Downloaded GEO counts:

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(tidyverse)
library(Orpheus)
seurat_obj = readRDS("../../Mouse_liver_data/liver_timecourse_seurat_object.Rds")

seurat_obj$seurat_clusters = seurat_obj$all_cell_types
```

Take TauFisher clustering:

```{r}
DimPlot(seurat_obj, reduction = "umap", group.by = "all_cell_types")
```

Add ZT information to Seurat object:

```{r}
table(seurat_obj$orig.ident)

matches <- stringr::str_match(seurat_obj$orig.ident , "ZT(\\d+)$")
ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])
seurat_obj$ZT = ZT
```

## Now do Methods of Moments analysis (ORPHEUS)

```{r}
cluster_phis = list()
for(cell_type in unique(seurat_obj$seurat_clusters)){
  
tmp = extract_clstr_prep_input(seurat_obj, cluster_id = cell_type, clip_sd = 10)

#Get Pseudobulk and variance for each gene for each subject
pb_mat = tmp[[1]]
var_mat = tmp[[2]]

#Recover time in hours that sample was collected
matches <- stringr::str_match(colnames(pb_mat) , "ZT(\\d+)")
ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])

if(length(unique(diff(ZT))) != 1 || length(unique(ZT)) < 6){
  print("Cell does not have time points suitable for analysis")
  next
}

#Call cosinor regression methods, where phases of variance wave are NOT fixed:
pb_cycling = is_cycling(ZT, pb_mat)
var_cyclers = var_cycling(ZT, var_mat, pb_mat)
  
#Get info to run var_cycling_fix_acro, where phases ARE fixed
phase_pb = filter(pb_cycling, as.numeric(p_statistic) < 0.05) %>% select(acrophase_bulk) %>% unname %>% unlist
circ_genes = filter(pb_cycling, as.numeric(p_statistic) < 0.05) %>% select(Gene_Symbols) %>% unname %>% unlist


#hist(as.numeric(phase_pb))

#Run cosinor regression on variance data, where phases are fixed.
var_cyclers_fixed = var_cycling_fix_acro(ZT, var_mat[circ_genes,], pb_mat[circ_genes,], phase_pb)

#Run metacycle to find pb and variance rhythms:
meta2d_res = cycling_meta2d(ZT, var_mat, pb_mat, out_file_circ = "input_12hr.txt", out_file_mean = "input_24hr.txt", out_file_pb = "input_pb.txt",out_dir = "~/Desktop/test/")

#collect the results from metacycle:
doub_cyclers_meta2d = meta2d_res[[1]]
fund_cycling_meta2d = meta2d_res[[2]] %>% rename(fund_amp = fund_amplitude)
pb_cyclers_meta2d = meta2d_res[[3]] %>% mutate(acrophase_bulk = acrophase_bulk*pi/12)

#Below we create a dataframe of metacycle results comparable to var_cyclers
var_cycling_meta2d_res = merge(doub_cyclers_meta2d, fund_cycling_meta2d , by = "Gene_Symbols", all = TRUE) %>% mutate(double_freq_acrophase =double_freq_acrophase*pi/12 ) %>% mutate(fund_acro = fund_acrophase *pi/12)
  
#How do the meta2d vs cosinor results compare?##########
# merge(pb_cycling, pb_cyclers_meta2d, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffixes = c("_cos","_meta" )) %>%
#   filter(p_statistic_cos < 0.05 & p_statistic_meta < 0.05)%>%
# ggplot()+
#   geom_point(aes((as.numeric(amplitude_bulk_cos)),as.numeric(amplitude_bulk_meta)))+ylim(c(0,2*pi))+xlim(c(0,2*pi))
# 
# merge(var_cyclers, var_cycling_meta2d_res, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffixes = c("_cos","_meta" )) %>%
#   filter(double_freq_p_statistic_cos < 0.1 & double_freq_p_statistic_meta < 0.1)%>%
# ggplot()+
#   geom_point(aes((as.numeric(double_freq_amplitude_cos)),as.numeric(double_freq_amplitude_meta)))#+ylim(c(0,pi))+xlim(c(0,pi))
############################################

# phi_meta2d = Orpheus::calc_phi(ZT, pb_cycling_results = pb_cycling, var_cycling_results = var_cycling_meta2d_res, var_p_thr = .05, expected_acrodiff_thr = .5, bulk_amp_thr = 0.2)
expected_acrodiff_thr = 0.785
input_meta2d = var_cycling_meta2d_res %>%
  left_join(pb_cycling, by = "Gene_Symbols") %>%
     mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
     filter(p_statistic < 0.05) %>%
     mutate(acrodiff = (double_freq_acrophase - acrophase_bulk) %% pi) %>%
     mutate(keep_acrodiff = acrodiff < (pi / 2 + expected_acrodiff_thr) & acrodiff > (pi / 2 - expected_acrodiff_thr)) %>%
     dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,var_mesor,amplitude_bulk, mesor_bulk, fund_amp,  everything()) %>%
     filter(amplitude_bulk >= 0.5) %>%
     column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")

#hist(input_meta2d$acrodiff, main = "Meta2d acrodiff")
 
phi_meta2d = input_meta2d %>%
  apply(., 1, function(row) {
    Orpheus::find_analytic(row[1], row[2], row[3], row[4])
  }) %>%
  t %>%
  as.data.frame
colnames(phi_meta2d) = c("G_pred", "Ac_pred", "phi")
print(paste0("meta2d: ", sum(!is.nan(phi_meta2d$phi)), "/",nrow(input_meta2d), " phi's not nan"  ))

print(paste0("meta2d: ", sum(input_meta2d$keep_acrodiff), "/",nrow(input_meta2d), " have double freq acro within 0.785 rads of pi/2"  ))
output_meta2d = merge(phi_meta2d, input_meta2d, by = 0)

#### cosinor results 1 ###
# phi = Orpheus::calc_phi(ZT, pb_cycling_results = pb_cycling, var_cycling_results = var_cyclers, var_p_thr = 1, expected_acrodiff_thr = 1, cycling_p_thr = 0.05, bulk_amp_thr = 0.5)

input_cos = var_cyclers %>% 
     left_join(pb_cycling, by = "Gene_Symbols") %>%
     mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
     filter(p_statistic < 0.05) %>%
     mutate(acrodiff = (double_freq_acrophase - acrophase_bulk) %% pi) %>%
     mutate(keep_acrodiff = acrodiff < (pi / 2 + expected_acrodiff_thr) & acrodiff > (pi / 2 - expected_acrodiff_thr)) %>%
     dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,var_mesor,amplitude_bulk, mesor_bulk, fund_amp, partial_model_AIC, full_model_AIC,  everything()) %>%
     filter(amplitude_bulk >= 0.5) %>%
     column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")%>%
     filter(partial_model_AIC > full_model_AIC)


hist(input_cos$acrodiff)
  # Calculate phi parameters
phi_cos = input_cos %>%
  apply(., 1, function(row) {
    Orpheus::find_analytic(row[1], row[2], row[3], row[4])
  }) %>%
  t %>%
  as.data.frame
colnames(phi_cos) = c("G_pred", "Ac_pred", "phi")
print(paste0("cosinor: ", sum(!is.nan(phi_cos$phi)), "/",nrow(input_cos), " phi's not nan"  ))
print(paste0("cosinor: ", sum(input_cos$keep_acrodiff), "/",nrow(input_cos), " have double freq acro within 0.785 rads of pi/2"  ))

output_cos = merge(phi_cos, input_cos, by = 0)

# ggplot() +

#     y = "Double Frequency Amplitude (input$double_freq_amplitude)"
#   ) +
#   theme_minimal()+ylim(0, 10)+xlim(0, 20)

#### cosinor results  2 (fixed acrophase) ###
input_cos_fix = var_cyclers_fixed %>% 
     left_join(pb_cycling, by = "Gene_Symbols") %>%
    mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
    filter(p_statistic < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,var_mesor,amplitude_bulk, mesor_bulk, fund_amp, partial_model_AIC, full_model_AIC,  everything()) %>%
    filter(amplitude_bulk >= 0.5) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")%>%
    filter(partial_model_AIC > full_model_AIC)

  # Calculate phi parameters
phi_cos_fix = input_cos_fix %>%
  apply(., 1, function(row) {
    Orpheus::find_analytic(row[1], row[2], row[3], row[4])
  }) %>%
  t %>%
  as.data.frame
colnames(phi_cos_fix) = c("G_pred", "Ac_pred", "phi")
print(paste0("cosinor fixed acro: ", sum(!is.nan(phi_cos_fix$phi)), "/",nrow(input_cos_fix), " phi's not nan"  ))

output_cos_fix = merge(phi_cos_fix, input_cos_fix, by = 0)

 local_res =  list("cos" = output_cos, "fix" = output_cos_fix, "meta2d" = output_meta2d)
 names(local_res) = paste(cell_type, names(local_res))
 cluster_phis <- append(cluster_phis, list(local_res))

}
```

```{r}
cos_phis <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(cluster_phis), function(source_name) {
  current_df <- cluster_phis[[source_name]][[1]]
  current_df$Source <- names(cluster_phis[[source_name]][1])
  current_df
}))

cos_fixed_phis <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(cluster_phis), function(source_name) {
  current_df <- cluster_phis[[source_name]][[2]]
  current_df$Source <- names(cluster_phis[[source_name]][2])
  current_df
}))

meta2d_phis <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(cluster_phis), function(source_name) {
  current_df <- cluster_phis[[source_name]][[3]]
  current_df$Source <- names(cluster_phis[[source_name]][3])
  current_df
}))


cos_phis_filt = filter(cos_phis, keep_acrodiff == T & !is.nan(phi))
table(cos_phis_filt$Source)

cos_fixed_phis = filter(cos_fixed_phis, !is.nan(phi))
table(cos_fixed_phis$Source)

meta2d_phis_filt = filter(meta2d_phis, keep_acrodiff == T & !is.nan(phi))
table(meta2d_phis_filt$Source)
```
